candidates.title: Anthropic Restores Claude Fable 5 Globally and Launches Claude Sonnet 5
candidates.description: Anthropic restored global access to Claude Fable 5 after an 18-day suspension under a U.S. export control order, deploying it with a new safety classifier to prevent safety bypasses. Simultaneously, Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, offering near-Opus-level reasoning for Free and Pro users while restricting hazardous cybersecurity capabilities.
candidates.significance: The resolution of the first major frontier model export control shutdown sets a key regulatory precedent, while Sonnet 5 represents the next step in model capability tiering.

candidates.title: UN Launches AI for Good Global Commission
candidates.description: The United Nations and the ITU officially established the AI for Good Global Commission, co-chaired by Marc Benioff and Paul Kagame, and featuring tech leaders including Jensen Huang, Andy Jassy, and Brad Smith, to develop international standards and address the global AI infrastructure gap.
candidates.significance: The first comprehensive global commission bringing together top tech leaders and heads of state to establish international norms and address AI infrastructure inequality.

candidates.title: FTC Proposes Policy Restricting Deceptive 'Ideological' AI Steering
candidates.description: The Federal Trade Commission issued a proposed policy statement warning AI developers that quietly steering or distorting model outputs to achieve undisclosed ideological, political, or social objectives could violate Section 5 of the FTC Act prohibiting deceptive practices.
candidates.significance: Marks a major regulatory shift where government bodies begin to police post-training alignment, safety tuning, and output steering under consumer protection laws.

candidates.title: OpenAI Proposes 5% Equity Stake to U.S. Government
candidates.description: To align itself with national security priorities and address regulatory pressure ahead of its IPO, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman proposed allocating a 5% equity stake-worth approximately $42.6 billion-to a U.S. government public investment vehicle.
candidates.significance: A historic shift in corporate governance where a major frontier AI lab proposes direct public equity ownership to navigate national security concerns and secure a regulatory license to operate.
